description: Defines an immutable data object 'AccountTransferData' representing account transfer details within the Fineract project, including transfer metadata, account info, and options for transfer between accounts.

classes.name: AccountTransferData
classes.description: Immutable data object representing a transfer between accounts, including transfer details, account info, and options for selection.
